companyDescription: Semiconductor test & burn-in equipment · FOX-XP wafer-level burn-in for AI processors, SiC and GaN · FQ1 FY27 revenue $33.0M (+200%), bookings $46.7M, effective backlog $109.3M · FY27 revenue outlook raised to $150M
priceNote: Live $48.51 (+21.76%, Nov 23 close, Yahoo). About 67% below the $145.61 52-week high and ~37% below the 200-day (~$76.58), though still well above the 52-week low ($20.19). The stock gave back its post-earnings +26% pop (Nov 3) in the November semis crash.
summary: A profitable equipment name whose fundamentals beat while its multiple collapsed. FQ1 FY27 revenue was a record $33.0M (+200%), adjusted EPS $0.28, bookings $46.7M (>1.4x book-to-bill) and effective backlog $109.3M, and the FY27 revenue outlook was raised to $150M, about triple FY26. Cash is $105.1M with near-breakeven operating cash flow, so survival is not in question. Analysts cut targets on sector multiple compression but still sit far above the price: Jefferies $140, Lake Street $90. The next print is ~late January (no date announced). Base +55% is a 3–6 month horizon re-rating toward the 200-day, above the turbo P75 (21.5%). แนะนำ 2% ของ portfolio เท่านั้น — semis beta สูง ถ้า AI capex ชะลอ ลงได้ 40%.

catalysts.name: FQ2 FY27 results
catalysts.description: Quarter ending ~late Dec. Watch whether bookings stay above revenue and whether the $150M FY27 outlook is held or raised. Date not yet announced; FQ1 was reported Nov 2.

catalysts.name: AI processor burn-in orders
catalysts.description: Follow-on FOX-XP orders from hyperscaler AI-processor customers are the platform driver behind the $109.3M backlog; any new named customer is upside.

risks: Customer concentration: a few AI-processor and SiC customers drive bookings; one delayed order can swing a quarter (AEHR fell ~44% between its prior two reports).
Semicap multiple compression: Jefferies ($175→$140) and Lake Street ($110→$90) cut targets despite a beat-and-raise.
SiC end-market (EV) remains weak; the thesis now rests on the AI burn-in ramp.
Cash fell ~$11M in the quarter to $105.1M; a prior public offering appears in the cash-flow statement, so dilution is possible if growth needs working capital.
Macro WAIT (15/100); SOX-beta names led the Nov selloff.

macroRisk.rateOutlook: Fed funds 3.75–4.00%. CME FedWatch prices a +25bp hike at the Dec 9 FOMC at ~91% (Nov 23); futures dropped the 50bp tail after the November selloff.
macroRisk.inflationNote: Oct core CPI +0.3% m/m (hot). Sep core PCE 3.1% y/y; Oct PCE (Nov 25) consensus 3.2% is the last inflation print before the Fed.
macroRisk.sectorImpact: Semicap equipment is cyclical and high-beta to AI capex sentiment; rate hikes compress multiples, but AEHR's profitability and backlog make it less fragile than pre-revenue turbo names.
macroRisk.summary: MEDIUM — /macro is WAIT (15/100, high conviction): S&P 7,237 is still below its 200-day (~7,340) after the Nov 23 +4.7% squeeze, VIX 27, breadth ~43% above 50DMA, HY OAS widening to ~3.52%. Turbo prior is unproven in this regime (0/107 windows had SPY down >2%).
